title: 350MW data center campus proposed in New South Wales, Australia
html:
A large data center campus is being planned in rural New South Wales, Australia.

Per local press, Lambruk Mulwala Futures Pty Ltd is aiming to develop a data center campus on 27 hectares near Mulwala.

Mulwala is a town in the Federation Council local government area in the Riverina district of New South Wales. Close to the state border with Victoria, Mulwala is around 270km (167 miles) northeast of Melbourne.

Developed in three phases, the project could reportedly total 350MW at full build-out. The site would use closed-loop cooling to reduce water use.

The project site is near an existing substation and European Energy’s Mulwala Solar Farm, bordered by Tocumwal Road, Savernake Road and Lambruk Lane. The land is owned by local farmer Douglas Thomas.

Lambruk Mulwala Futures is led by Greg Ley, CEO of Australian planning consultancy firm Lecroma. The firm is reportedly looking for a larger capital partner to take the project forward.
summary: Project planned near Mulwala substation and solar farm
